correctness.rationale: The action on rook faces has exactly one A5-orbit for sizes up to three and exactly two for sizes four and five, and no simplex inversions. Oriented face deletion gives an explicit integral CW boundary. A unimodular parity change of basis reduces H3 to coker [U R] on four-subsets; derivation uses exactness of the augmented simplex chains, not a finite guess. A standalone checker rebuilds full A5 orbits and boundaries, verifies square-zero, modular ranks and exact Smith factors n=4..8 (n=8 factors 3 six times and 6 once). Low homotopy is two-connected and four-dimensional CW Smith diagonalization implies the stated Moore-and-sphere wedges. No result outside n<=8 or independent mathematical audit is claimed.

value.rationale: The A5 group is the natural index-two alternating symmetry of a standard partially injective-label topological complex. Its parity branching gives a structural explanation and explicit finite cutoff for integral torsion: width seven produces 3-primary torsion; width eight produces simultaneous 2- and 3-primary factors and a complete homotopy wedge. This is not just relabeling, a cheap normalization test or a routine recomputation of labeled chessboard Betti numbers. The result has precise finite object-and-width motivation and reproducibility; no general n theorem is claimed.
